Monolingual recordings are wrongly translated as monosyllabic recordings; this changes the calibration-data assumption. Visible publication date is month-level only.

findings.finding: 自動生成される判定・修正案はモデルの誤りを含み得るため人のレビューを要するという原典の条件を要約へ追記する。

notes.comparison: Primary supports Taskflow/AFL++ autonomous harness/coverage/crash/report stages, host arbitrary-command execution and disposable unprivileged environment requirement. It explicitly says suggested patches are review-required and model verdicts are a starting point for human review. Preserve that material limitation alongside the autonomous pipeline description.

findings.finding: Accountable事業者の名称をアカウント対象企業と誤訳している。提供機能と期限付き対応約束による指定と説明する。
Bingのrobots.txt連携は2027年初頭予定であり、設定だけで全3社へ現在通知されるとはしない。NOARCHIVE等の別途指定を明記する。

notes.comparison: Compared mixed-use behavior, Training/Search/Agent settings, migration, Accountable designation, operator-specific support and future summary controls. Accountable is not account-target-company. Current primary explicitly states Bing robots.txt no-training support is targeted early 2027 and is not automatically conveyed today; NOARCHIVE or removal tools are needed meanwhile. Record this current limitation without assuming when the source added its clarification.

findings.finding: 17%のtoken削減と350 token/秒はArtificial Analysisの評価・測定であり、全タスクの保証として記述しない。
本日利用可能なのは3.6 Flashと3.5 Flash-Lite。Cyberは政府・信頼されたパートナー向けの今後の限定pilotであり3モデル共通の一般公開としない。

notes.comparison: Primary joint launch supports the three models, but the 17% output-token reduction and 350 tokens/s are Artificial Analysis measurements rather than every workload. General availability that day applies only to 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite; Cyber is a future limited government/trusted-partner CodeMender pilot. Narrow benchmark and availability wording.

Primary supports Effective E2B/E4B, 26B MoE/31B dense, Apache 2.0, 31B open-model ranking at announcement, edge offline use, all-model vision/video/code/140+ languages and edge 128K versus large 256K contexts. The Note does not claim every model has native audio or every model supports 256K. Hardware/availability remain a product announcement, not an independent device benchmark.

findings.finding: 有限回のpass@k実験を、推論OFFでは知識へ到達できないという絶対的不能の証明にしない。今回の評価で到達しにくかったとする。

notes.comparison: Compared pass@k closed-book on/off experiments, named models/datasets, matched-length dummy traces, factual priming and search-verified intermediate facts/test-time selection. The summary preserves empirical scope, but a key point claims facts are unreachable with reasoning off; finite pass@k evidence supports virtually unrecoverable in this evaluation, not impossibility. Narrow that statement.

The Note otherwise preserves simulated patient-actor status and need for real-patient validation; correct participant roles.
